title: German Apple Strudel
description: A classic German dessert made with layers of flaky pastry and sweet apple filling. This recipe is perfect for a cozy evening with family or friends.
instructions: Roll out the filo pastry and cut it into 4 equal pieces.
In a bowl, mix together the sliced apples, cinnamon, and sugar.
Place one piece of filo pastry on a flat surface and brush with melted butter.
Place a quarter of the apple mixture on the pastry, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the pastry over the filling to form a triangle and press the edges to seal.
Repeat with the remaining pastry and apple mixture.
Place the strudels on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and brush the tops with the beaten egg.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve warm with a scoop of vanilla ice cream, if desired.
